text: At 2.1.18 M10 `m10mcp00` renders `list_plans` in `transagent-tools` for the top-level chat thread (with M44 `3f5ej79s` and M05 `iatop5pj`), but `katalog-operacji-m10` has no `list_plans` row yet (a Faza B todo in the same section). Built as the prose says: `list_plans` is a tool on `transagent-tools` (src/server/mcp/transagent-tools.ts), params `applied?`, `limit?`, `offset?`; no catalog row was added. Three open points decided here: (1) no `search` parameter on the internal tool — `search_plans` is `n/a` and the prose names only the `applied` filter, although the service row `ww4lujgo` keeps `search?` (the external `plan-tools` mcp mount's `list_plans` is unchanged); (2) the default page size is `DEFAULT_LIMITS.listPlans = 50` (M39 asks for a finite default but names no number); (3) the order conflict noted by the `ww4lujgo` todo is resolved as two orders of one function: `PlanService.listPlans({ order })` — default `'updated'` (most-recently-changed first, the /plans page and REST unchanged, `ac-planservice-listplans-search-limit`), `'created'` for `list_plans` (`created_at` asc, tie `path`, undated last). Rows: `{ path, title, applied, createdAt, updatedAt }`, no content. Suggest completing Faza B: the catalog row (`internal: direct` via transagent-tools) and the `mcp-tool` entity `transagent-tools-list-plans` with these params/returns, and resolving the `ww4lujgo` todo as 'two orders of one function'.
